narrative.overview: PRF is a fellowship's tool for sending people out and caring for them while they are there. Navy is the root: steady, deep, trustworthy. Lime is the new growth: rare, alive, only ever a point of emphasis. Everything else is calm paper and quiet ink so the content carries the screen. Built for people aged 18 to 90, mostly non-technical, often on a phone with patchy signal.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy brand surfaces with the Living Root motif; white working surfaces.
Lime as a sparing accent and fill, never as text on white.
Soft, generous corners and soft navy-tinted shadows.
Accessibility as a floor: AA contrast, 48dp targets, reduced motion, scalable type.

rules.name: The Lime Is Never Ink Rule
rules.body: Lime is a fill and an accent. Never set lime text or thin lime icons on white or paper.

rules.name: The Pair, Not the Paint Rule
rules.body: Status colours are used as sets: text on a fill uses onColor, text on a tint uses foreground.

rules.name: The Theme Owns Colour Rule
rules.body: Widget code reads colour from the theme; raw literals live only in the theme layer.

rules.name: The Twelve Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing renders below labelSmall (12sp base, never under 11sp after scaling).

rules.name: The Grow, Don't Clip Rule
rules.body: Text containers use minimum heights, never fixed heights.

dos: Do take every colour from colorScheme, context.prfColors or context.statusColors, and pair status fills with their onColor.
Do keep every tappable element at 48dp or larger and give icon-only buttons a localised tooltip.
Do route every animation duration and delay through PRFMotionTokens.resolve(context, …), and cap list staggers (eight items, 400ms).
Do use spacing, radius, size, opacity and shadow tokens for every value.
Do write user-facing copy in plain words: say what happened and what to do next.
Do test new widgets in dark mode and at 2× text scale.
donts: Don't put lime text on white or white text on lime.
Don't set raw fontSize: or build a TextStyle from scratch; nothing below 12sp.
Don't wrap text in fixed-height boxes.
Don't show an error as an empty state, or show raw exception text or HTTP codes to users.
Don't fork a design-system widget inside an app.
Don't use PRFColors.*, Colors.* or hex literals in widget code.
